{{Quote|Well, I was born here for starters. My parents were Outcasts, banished to the Undercity for some crime or other&hellip; they never really liked to talk about it. Everyone here is an Outcast&hellip; or the descendant of one. It's tough down here, but we survive. I guess it's easier for me, since I've never known anything different.|Shaleena to Revan on the Outcasts and the Undercity|<ref name="kotor" />}}
'''Shaleena''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Reproduction/Legends|born]] into the [[Undercity (Taris)|Undercity]] [[Outcasts (Taris)|Outcasts]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Taris/Legends|Taris]]. Kept away from the world's surface, they would dream about it and listened to the storyteller [[Rukil|Rukil's]] tales of the fabled [[Promised Land]], even into her adulthood. During the [[Jedi Civil War]] in [[3956 BBY]], they ran off two beggars from her [[Undercity (Taris)|village]] away from the amnesic former [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Revan/Legends|Revan]]. Shaleena then talked with him about her dreams and life in the Undercity. The man would later find the [[Promised Land journals|journals]] to the Promised Land, making Shaleena and the Outcasts leave the village to find it.

==Biography==
===Stuck in the Undercity===
{{Quote|He used to tell me the greatest stories when I was a little girl. I still like to listen to his tales about the Promised Land, even though I know they're just legends. But it helps to make the Undercity seem less&hellip; less dark, somehow.|Shaleena on Rukil|<ref name="kotor" />}}
[[File:TarisUndercity-KOTORVG.jpg|thumb|right|350px|Shaleena lived in the Outcast village in the Taris Undercity (pictured).]]
Shaleena, a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] who was the child of at least two [[Parent/Legends|parents]], was [[Reproduction/Legends|born]] in the [[Undercity (Taris)|Undercity]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Taris/Legends|Taris]]. Their parents, following a crime they had committed, became part of the [[Outcasts (Taris)|Outcasts]], a group of people shunned from Taris's surface and banished to the Undercity, where they lived impoverished in a [[Outcast village|village]].<ref name="kotor" />

Shaleena had never known anything different than being an Outcast and dreamed of seeing the planet's [[Upper City]]. When they were a girl, the Outcast storyteller [[Rukil]] would tell stories of what it was like on the surface, and of the [[Promised Land]], a fabled paradise located somewhere in the Undercity. They continued to listen to stories when they were an adult during the [[Jedi Civil War]]<ref name="kotor" /> in [[3956 BBY]].<ref name="kotorcg">''[[Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide]]'' dates the events of ''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]'' to [[3956 BBY]].</ref>

===A savior from the Upper City===
{{Quote|Go on, you two! Get out of here! I'm sorry about that&hellip; those two beggars give everyone in the village a bad name! We aren't all like that, you know. Most of us are good people.|Shaleena apologizes to Revan for two beggars actions|<ref name="kotor" />}}
In that [[Standard year/Legends|year]], the ''[[Endar Spire]]'', a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], was attacked by the [[Sith Empire/Legends|Sith Empire]], who were occupying Taris, over the world. The amnesiac former [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Revan/Legends|Revan]], believing<ref name="kotor" /> he<ref name="Revan">''[[The Old Republic: Revan]]''</ref> was a member of the Galactic Republic, crash landed on the planet and began to search for the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Bastila Shan]] with the soldier [[Carth Onasi]]. In his search, he visited the village, where he was hassled by two Outcast beggars. Shaleena ran off the two and apologized for their actions to Revan.<ref name="kotor" />

{{GameMechanics|legends=1}}
Shaleena then asked Revan if he was from the Upper City and asked what he thought of it. After he gave his opinion, Shaleena told the<ref name="kotor" /> man<ref name="Revan" /> about their dreams of the Upper City and Rukil's stories. Revan asked them for information on Rukil, the Promised Land, village and its leader [[Gendar]], and the Republic [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pods]] that had crashed in the Under City. Shaleena helped him with all, sans the escape pods, which they had no knowledge on. The man then left them, but not before Shaleena offered him to come to them if he needed anything or if he wanted to talk.<ref name="kotor" />

Not long after, Revan agreed to help Rukil with finding the [[Promised Land journals|journals]] to the Promised Land. After the man had learned the history of the Outcasts from Rukil, he talked with Shaleena again, who compared him to the savior from Rukil's stories and wished him luck. Revan eventually found all three journals and gave them to Rukil. The discoveries gave the Outcasts renewed hope and they left their village in mass exodus to traverse the Undercity for the locale.<ref name="kotor" />
{{EndGame}}

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|I've never been to the surface, but sometimes I think I can see it in my dreams. The sun, the sky, the stars, it all sounds so&hellip; so&hellip; so wonderful. Gendar, the leader of our village, tells me I should spend more time trying to improve things down here and less time dreaming about something I can never have.|Shaleena to Revan|<ref name="kotor" />}}
[[File:TarisUpperCityConcept1.jpg|thumb|left|300px|Shaleena would dream of Taris's Upper City (pictured).]]
Shaleena dreamed of seeing the Upper City and imagined it would be beautiful, though Gendar would tell them to stop dreaming about something they would never see and to improve the Outcast's living situation. Even when they were no longer a girl, they would still listen to the stories of the Promised Land told by Rukil as to them, they somehow made the Undercity less dark. They considered the stories to be legends, however. When talking to Revan, they described Rukil as kind.<ref name="kotor" />

{{GameMechanics|legends=1}}
Upon meeting Revan, they told him about their dreams but thought the man probably viewed her as a fool. Shaleena allowed Revan to come back to them if they ever needed anything or simply just wanted to talk, as they hardly ever talked to someone from the Upper City. When Revan returned to talk to her again, they were glad and found their rare time talking to someone from the Upper City neat.<ref name="kotor" />
{{Endgame}}

==Equipment==
Like other Outcasts, Shaleena wore tattered [[Clothing/Legends|clothing]] of black, brown, and gray colors.<ref name="kotor" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|I saw what you did! You gave those journals to Igear! Now we'll never find the promised land! How could you do that, you monster! Just get away from me! I don't want to speak to you again!|Shaleena to Revan, if the player chooses to give the Promised Land journals to Igear|<ref name="kotor" />}}
[[File:ShaleenaUnusedModel-KOTOR.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Shaleena's unused appearance]]
Shaleena first appeared in the video game ''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]'', developed by [[BioWare]]<ref name="kotor" /> and released on [[July 15]], [[2003]].<ref name="Anniversary">{{SW|url=news/kotor-galaxy-of-heroes|text=BioWare and Capital Games on Bringing ''KotOR'' Fan Favorites into ''Galaxy of Heroes''|nolive=1}}</ref> An alternative appearance for the Shaleena&mdash;with blue eyes and brown hair with dark roots&mdash;was left in the game's code, though was not used in the final game.<ref name="kotor" /> The [[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic: Prima's Official Strategy Guide|official strategy guide]] for the game, written by [[David Hodgson]] and published by [[Prima Games]]<ref name="Prima">[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic: Prima's Official Strategy Guide|''Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic'': Prima's Official Strategy Guide]]</ref> in [[July]] of 2003,<ref name="Date">{{CargoBay|url=item-detail/12540|text=Knights of the Old Republic}}</ref> uses the alternate appearance and shows the character in lighter-colored clothing.<ref name="Prima" />

When talking to Shaleena for the first time, the player can choose to describe the Upper City in different ways. If the player chooses to say the city is beautiful, Shaleena has no extra dialogue and continues to the next line. Telling them it is nothing special provides an extra line for Shaleena, where they comment that Revan is probably used to the city's beauty. Another extra line is given when the player says the Upper City is better than the "festering slime pit" the woman lives in. Shaleena will believe that the world does not look like much to Revan, but that it is the only world they have ever known. If the player brushes off Shaleena, they will be apologetic but still offer coming back to talk to them.<ref name="kotor" /> 

If the player makes the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] choice of giving the Promised Land journals to the Undercity merchant [[Igear]], who will destroy them and prevent the Outcasts from finding the Promised Land, Shaleena will tell Revan they saw his dealing and calls him a monster, ending their dialogue by saying they will never talk to him again.<ref name="kotor" />
